    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    nodes = seg['nodes']
    greens = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
    if not greens:
        print(f"No more green blocks after {i} clicks")

    leftmost = min(greens, key=lambda g: min(pt[1] for pt in g['boundary']))
    boundary = leftmost['boundary']
    rows = [pt[0] for pt in boundary]
    cols = [pt[1] for pt in boundary]

    center_col = sum(cols) // len(cols)
    
    action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center_row, 'col': center_col}])
    
    greens_after = [n for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
    print(f"Click {i+1}: ({center_row}, {center_col}) -> {len(greens_after)} greens, game_over={last_action_result.get('game_over')}")
    
    if last_action_result.get('game_over'):
        print("GAME OVER! Stopping.")
        break
    if last_action_result.get('level_completed'):
        print("LEVEL COMPLETED!")
        break
</parameter>
